Implemented the fix in [SettleSubscriptionJob.php](/app/var/workspaces/double-refund--laravel-13--1/app/Jobs/SettleSubscriptionJob.php).
Diagnosis: `failed()` always issued a second refund, including when settlement had already recorded the refund and failed only during marketplace cancellation.
Fix:
- Centralized refund logic in `refundIfNeeded()`.
- Skips BillingHub when a refund ledger entry already exists.
- Preserves compensation for genuine pre-refund failures.
- Serializes concurrent settlement attempts using a subscription row lock.
- Uses the actual BillingHub refund amount.
Validation: `vendor/bin/phpunit` passes.
